## Prompt (verbatim)

```text
Implemente a questão de gerar lista de exercícios

planeje como vai ficar no banco isso, e crie mais uma section em materiais de lista de exercícios geradas
```

## Outcome (English, 3–5 lines)

New collection `exercise_lists` (one document per list, questions embedded, status generating/ready/failed, book, lesson, pages, model and prompt version). `POST /api/exercise-lists` (202) creates it from an intervention's topic and gap ids; `ExerciseListService` finds the book and lesson where the difficulty starts and `ClaudeExerciseGenerator` (Opus 5.5, structured outputs, refusal fallback) writes 3 multiple-choice + 2 open questions from up to 12 pages of the book. The intervention card generates and shows the list; Materiais has "Listas de exercícios geradas" with the two PDFs and delete. Verified live: a real list in ~15 s, grounded in lesson L2 (p. 20–25).
